title: New Interventions by silicone grease in synthesis

synthesis.procedure: Under purified nitrogen using vacuum-nitrogen line and dry-box techniques, scandium filings (0.32 g, 2.3 mmol), Hg(C6F5)2 (1.1 g, 2.0 mmol), and Me2pzH (0.39 g, 4.0 mmol) were added to a silicone-greased Schlenk flask and stirred in THF (15 mL) at room temperature for one week. The suspension was filtered through Celite, concentrated in vacuo to 5 mL, and stored at ~4 °C for one week. After no crystals formed, the mixture was heated and slowly cooled to room temperature, then stored at −25 °C for several weeks to give small colourless crystals of 1.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature, then heating/cooling, then −25 °C crystallization
synthesis.time: stirred 1 week; stored ~4 °C 1 week; stored −25 °C several weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: silicone-greased Schlenk flask; vacuum-nitrogen line / dry box under purified nitrogen; Celite filtration
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered through Celite, concentrated to 5 mL in vacuo; after failed crystallization at ~4 °C, heated and slowly cooled, then stored at −25 °C to give colourless crystals

material_class.structural_family: oxo-bridged tetranuclear mixed-oxidation-state cerium pyrazolate/siloxide cluster

synthesis.procedure: Under purified nitrogen, Ce metal (0.60 g, 4.3 mmol), Hg(C6F5)2 (1.22 g, 2.28 mmol) and Me2pzH (0.43 g, 4.5 mmol) were stirred in THF in a silicone-greased Schlenk flask for several days. The solution was filtered from metal residues and evaporated to dryness. Most of the resulting white powder, identified as [Ce2(Me2pz)6(thf)2] (60–70%), was scraped from the flask. Residual powder was dissolved in PhMe (10 mL) and heated to 60 °C, turning from light yellow to deep red within hours. Concentration and addition of hexane gave three crystal sets, including light pink crystals of 2a.
synthesis.temperature: stirring in THF (unspecified T); residual powder heated to 60 °C in PhMe
synthesis.time: stirred several days in THF; colour change within hours of heating in PhMe
synthesis.vessel_or_method: silicone-greased Schlenk flask; vacuum-nitrogen line / dry box under purified nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered from metal residues, evaporated to dryness; major [Ce2(Me2pz)6(thf)2] powder scraped away; residual powder dissolved in PhMe (10 mL), heated to 60 °C, concentrated, and treated with hexane to give light pink crystals of 2a together with 2b and 2c

material_class.structural_family: oxo-bridged tetranuclear mixed-oxidation-state cerium pyrazolate cluster

synthesis.procedure: Obtained from the same RTP reaction as 2a: Ce metal (0.60 g, 4.3 mmol), Hg(C6F5)2 (1.22 g, 2.28 mmol) and Me2pzH (0.43 g, 4.5 mmol) were stirred in THF in a silicone-greased Schlenk flask for several days, filtered, and evaporated. After removal of most [Ce2(Me2pz)6(thf)2], residual powder was dissolved in PhMe (10 mL), heated to 60 °C (yellow to deep red), concentrated, and treated with hexane to give small colourless crystals of 2b among 2a and 2c. Formation of 2b is attributed to exhaustion of the silicone-grease source.
synthesis.temperature: stirring in THF (unspecified T); residual powder heated to 60 °C in PhMe
synthesis.time: stirred several days in THF; colour change within hours of heating in PhMe
synthesis.vessel_or_method: silicone-greased Schlenk flask; vacuum-nitrogen line / dry box under purified nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: same mixed workup as 2a; hexane crystallization gave small colourless crystals of 2b

material_class.structural_family: mononuclear Ce(IV) 3,5-dimethylpyrazolate complex with coordinated Me2pzH

synthesis.procedure: Isolated from the same Ce RTP mixture as 2a/2b. After stirring Ce metal (0.60 g, 4.3 mmol), Hg(C6F5)2 (1.22 g, 2.28 mmol) and Me2pzH (0.43 g, 4.5 mmol) in THF for several days, filtration, evaporation, removal of most [Ce2(Me2pz)6(thf)2], dissolution of residual powder in PhMe (10 mL), heating to 60 °C, concentration, and addition of hexane afforded deep red crystals of 2c.
